name: Test Case - BILL01.jcl
businessFunction:
The JCL job BILL01 executes the BILLING program to perform monthly billing processing for customers. It reads customer and usage data from legacy billing files and generates or updates invoice records based on the consumption data.Key Functionalities:
Reads customer account information from the legacy billing customer file to identify accounts subject to monthly billing
Reads usage data from the legacy billing usage file to determine consumption amounts for each customer
Writes or updates invoice records to the legacy billing invoice file based on customer usage, producing the monthly billing output

dependencies.dependencyType: Close file; Open file; Read file
dependencies.name: CUSTOMER-FILE

entryPoints.name: BILL01.jcl
entryPoints.businessFunction: Read Usage Records - Read each customer usage record from the usage file, capturing customer ID, units consumed, and billing month Find Customer - Locate the matching customer record from the customer master file for each usage record Validate Customer Status - Verify the customer is active; skip and log an error for inactive or not-found customers Determine Usage Rate - Assign a per-unit billing rate based on tiered usage levels (up to 500 units: $0.50, 501–1000 units: $0.45, over 1000 units: $0.40) Calculate Usage Charge - Multiply total units consumed by the applicable per-unit rate to compute the gross usage charge Apply Volume Discount - Apply a 10% discount on the usage charge for customers exceeding 1000 units Apply Premium Customer Discount - Apply an additional 5% discount for customers classified as PREMIUM, on top of any volume discount Apply Minimum Charge Rule - Ensure the charge after discounts is at least $25.00; apply the minimum if the discounted amount falls below this threshold Calculate Tax - Compute the tax amount by applying the customer's individual tax rate to the taxable amount Calculate Final Invoice Amount - Sum the taxable amount, tax, and any previous outstanding balance to determine the total amount due Generate Invoice Number - Create a unique invoice number by combining the billing month and customer ID Format and Write Invoice Record - Format all monetary values and write the complete invoice record (invoice number, customer details, units, charges, discounts, tax, previous balance, and total due) to the invoice output file Billing Process Completion - Close all files and confirm completion of the billing process after all usage records are processed

testCaseBusinessRuleGuidance.name: STEP01 - BILLING - Monthly Invoice Generation
testCaseBusinessRuleGuidance.description: When the Monthly Billing job is triggered, the BILLING program reads the Customer Master file and the Usage Data file to calculate charges and produce invoice records into the Invoice file. The Invoice file must already exist and is exclusively locked during processing to ensure data integrity.
testCaseBusinessRuleGuidance.acceptanceCriteria: {"given": "The Customer Master file (CUSTOMER) containing customer account details is available for shared read access, AND the Usage Data file (USAGEIN) containing customer consumption or service usage records is available for shared read access, AND the Invoice file (INVOICE) already exists and is available for exclusive access", "when": "The Monthly Billing process is initiated and the BILLING program is executed", "then": "The BILLING program reads all customer account details from the Customer Master file, AND reads all usage and consumption records from the Usage Data file, AND calculates billing charges by matching each customer's usage records to their account, AND writes the resulting invoice records exclusively into the Invoice file, ensuring no other process can access the Invoice file during writing"}

testCaseGuidance.guidanceTitle: Monthly Invoice Generation with Customer and Usage Data Processing
testCaseGuidance.inputGuidance: The Customer Master file containing customer account details is available for read access. The Usage Data file containing customer consumption or service usage records is available for read access. The Invoice file already exists and is available for exclusive access. The Monthly Billing process is initiated.
testCaseGuidance.outputGuidance: The BILLING program reads all customer account details from the Customer Master file and reads all usage and consumption records from the Usage Data file. Billing charges are calculated by matching each customer's usage records to their account. The resulting invoice records are written exclusively into the Invoice file with no other process accessing it during writing.
